messages:
Maya (Support): Hi @James — saw your ticket about 429s hitting your Dedicated pool dp-west-3, forwarding to infra. Can you paste a sample request id + time?
James (Customer): thanks Maya. Here's one: req=01E5ZK4K9X7RPQ3H2V9A0Y1Z at 2026-03-15T14:02:11Z. Getting lots of 429s from runtime even though we have capacity reserved. Latency also spikes ~600ms before 429.
Maya (Support): Got it — filing here while SRE looks. @Oliver can you pull routing logs for tenant acme-inc around that req id?
deploy-bot: routing-checker started for thread 1955554321 (job 7521) :gear:
Oliver (SRE): grabbing logs. Quick note: symptoms look like requests are being routed to the shared burst pool instead of the dedicated pool, which would explain 429s. Investigating routing decision traces now.
Oliver (SRE): found a trace for req=01E5ZK4K9X7RPQ3H2V9A0Y1Z — controlplane evaluated policy set 'tier-preference' and matched pool 'shared-burst-small' (pool-id pb-s-09) even though header x-redwood-tier: ["gold","dedicated"] was present.
Priya (Control Plane): whoa — header looks like an array. Our policy engine expects a single-tier string or CSV; earlier change (mar 2026) normalized arrays by taking index 0, but array parsing has a bug: when the tier array contains quoted strings with spaces it picks the wrong index due to tokenization.
James (Customer): we do send tier as a JSON array from our proxy: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' \
  -H 'x-redwood-tier: ["gold","dedicated"]' \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```
Maya (Support): @Priya any quick mitigation for the customer while you patch parser? We need to stop routing to shared pool.
Priya (Control Plane): yes. Short-term: control plane accepts an override header x-redwood-pool-id. If James sets x-redwood-pool-id: dp-west-3 we can force selection. Also we can add a routing rule to prefer tenant acme-inc to dp-west-3 until patch. I'll apply the rule and confirm.
Oliver (SRE): applied temporary sticky route for tenant:acme-inc -> pool dp-west-3 (ttl 2h). I see requests for req=01E5ZK4K9X7RPQ3H2V9A0Y1Z now hitting dp-west-3 and 429s drop.
James (Customer): confirming — traffic looks healthy now, thanks. Will add fallback header for resilience.
Maya (Support): leaving steps to reproduce in ticket for eng: 1) send tier header as JSON array; 2) observe controlplane route picks first token incorrectly when array contains quotes/spaces; 3) runtime responds 429 if bucket reached.
Priya (Control Plane): filing bug CFG-3286: array header tokenization bug. Patch incoming: normalize arrays by JSON.parse when header begins with '[' and fallback to CSV parsing only when parse fails. Rolling a canary patch to staging now.
Oliver (SRE): adding monitoring alert: if dedicated pool differentials > 30% from expected routing for >5m, auto-create support incident and add tenant tag.
Maya (Support): Thanks team — I told James ETA ~4h for a staged fix and immediate workaround applied. I'll keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
James (Customer): appreciate the fast turnaround.
deploy-bot: canary deploy of controlplane-parser v1.12.7 -> staging (task 8812) started.
Priya (Control Plane): canary looks clean, merging to canary prod in 30m if no regressions. I will follow up here when merged.
